news.headline: A Look at IES Holdings Inc (IESC) After 8.8% Gain
news.summary: IESC shares rose 8.8% in one session in early November, recovering part of the October drawdown ahead of fiscal Q4 results.

news.headline: U.S. Markets Dropped Wednesday; IES Holdings Posted Biggest Loss
news.summary: Barron's named IES as the day's biggest loser in its market wrap on Oct 7. The selloff came two days after the debt-funded DBM Global acquisition closed.

news.headline: IES Holdings Ups Borrowing Capacity to $700 Million With Wells Fargo-Led Amended Credit Facility
news.summary: IES amended its credit agreement into a $200M term loan plus a $500M revolver, totaling $700M. It drew $525M to help fund the DBM Global purchase.

news.headline: IES Holdings Completes Acquisition of DBM Global
news.summary: IES closed the roughly $691M acquisition of steel fabricator and erector DBM Global from INNOVATE, paid mostly in cash plus IES shares. DBM becomes a new Structural segment.

news.headline: Director Joe Koshkin adds 92,000 IES Holdings shares
news.summary: A Form 4 shows director Joe D. Koshkin's reported holdings rose by 80,000 trust shares and 12,000 IRA shares as of Oct 1.

news.headline: IES Holdings Reports Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose 40% to $1.24B with operating income of $178.5M, and the company announced a two-for-one stock split.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q4 / FY2026 results
catalysts.detail: Not yet announced; last year's report came on Nov 21. Watch for FY2027 commentary that includes DBM Global, plus data-center backlog.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q1 2027 results (first quarter with DBM Global)
catalysts.detail: The first full quarter consolidating the new Structural segment and the $525M of acquisition debt.

pulse: IES has grown into a larger, more levered company after closing the ~$691M DBM Global acquisition, funded largely with $525M of new borrowings. The stock pulled back sharply in October and has partly recovered in early November. Fiscal Q4 results, expected around Nov 20, will be the first chance to hear management's FY2027 view including the new Structural segment.
